leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a Vue component with reactive state for user interaction testing
Implement event handlers to capture user inputs in Vue components
Bind form elements to Vue's reactive data model for two-way data flow
Render dynamic UI elements based on user interaction state
Configure Vue event modifiers to control event behavior in tests
Integrate user interaction logic with component methods for test scenarios
Manipulate DOM elements programmatically to simulate user actions in tests
